evidence.observation: pressure_gauge not_installed; growth stage requires tube pressure to verify atmosphere
null throughout, so pressure cannot be checked (e.g. for an exhaust blockage)
Purge brought O2 down from ~28,800 ppm to ~5 ppm; it has stayed at 4-7 ppm through growth, with no sign of a leak
Overshot to 760.1 at the start of growth, then settled to 750±0.3 °C
Tracks the 100 sccm setpoint within ±1 sccm

args.missing_evidence: A tube pressure reading (install or temporarily attach a gauge) to confirm the growth atmosphere is right and the exhaust is not blocked, and then characterization of the sample.
